Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production Unity nine-slice UI PANEL SPRITE texture, one single rectangular front surface, landscape aspect ratio 3:1.
Primary request: generate ONE front-on perfectly orthographic rectangular industrial metal UI plate with small clipped/bevelled corners, consistent with an adult stylized hand-painted 2.5D mining game. The plate fills nearly the entire canvas edge to edge, with only a few transparent pixels at the outer perimeter and small cut corner triangles. Flat straight horizontal/vertical edges, parallel opposite edges, NO perspective. The four corners are clipped by a tiny 45-degree diagonal, at most 32 pixel design depth; nine-slice compatible. Central 85 percent of the plate must be quiet, smooth, near-uniform light gray-white so live text remains readable.
CRITICAL COLORS: GRAYSCALE ONLY, neutral tintable metal texture. Interior RGB approximately 235, rim gray RGB approximately 170 to 230. Do not render a dark or colored plate: Unity will tint it petrol, amber, or teal. Restrained slightly darker broad bevelled rim, soft top-left light gives a tangible subtly sculpted matte surface, a few extremely subtle sparse handpainted metal strokes only, no distracting speckles or dense scratches. Matte practical chunky industrial geometry, sophisticated and calm, no ornate fantasy.
Transparency: true transparent alpha ONLY outside the panel silhouette and outside the clipped corners; the plate interior is opaque. No outer glow, shadow outside, drop shadow plane, background, fake checkerboard, scene, table, phone, artboard or additional panels.
Avoid: any text, symbols, icons, digits, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, screws, rivets, bolts, lights, colored pixels, ornamental decoration, inset subpanels, extra objects. Exactly one blank grayscale surface. Landscape 3:1.

visual_qa.bounds: Straight edges touch canvas bounds, alpha only outside clipped corners.
visual_qa.recommended_sprite_border: 48–64 pixels; 64 fully protects the clipped corners at 2172 px source width.

qa.alpha_verified: Character PNGs have real alpha (minimum 0; maximum 254). RGB in fully transparent pixels can contain a soft halo, but alpha=0 there.

usage.backdrops: Use as full-bleed 2D background; overlay real Unity UI and runtime characters. No mockup text is baked into the images.
usage.characters: Use RGBA with alpha blending. Do not use opaque material.
